label: Peplink MAX BR1 Mini HW3 (LTE-E)
description: Compact mobile router, HW3, EMEA LTE: 3x GE LAN (one convertible to WAN with PrimeCare), 300 Mbps throughput, Wi-Fi, PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port **0 / 1 (GE)**, Number of Ethernet LAN port **3 / 2 (GE)**, Router Throughput 300 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes, PoE Input Yes, SFP LAN/WAN No. The paired numbers are a licensing effect: with a PrimeCare subscription one LAN port can be turned into a WAN port, giving 1 WAN / 2 LAN instead of 0 WAN / 3 LAN. The base configuration is modelled; **a BR1 Mini with PrimeCare enabled has a different port split from this file.** The **-LTE-E** suffix is the EMEA LTE band set; the ports are identical to the LTEA SKUs, so only the band coverage differs.
